They are collected here because\n1275\teach was previously buried in the narrative of the section that fixed it, where an implementer\n1276\tstarting a later phase would never encounter it.\n1277\t\n1278\t| # | Anti-pattern | What it looked like | Guard |\n1279\t|---|---|---|---|\n1280\t| **AP1** | **A unit-free \"px/module\"** | Every optical run sat at 2.25 camera px/module while the config said \"4\". Presented as a symbology limit; was a sampling limit. | §2 defines screen px and camera px. Never write \"px/module\" unqualified. |\n1281\t| **AP2** | **The ROI ratchet** | A frame where only two tiles decoded shrank the crop to those two; every later frame then saw only that region and could never recover. Erasure 91%, goodput **worse than no cropping**, and it presents as an *optical* fault. | Wide margin (≥35%) **plus a forced full-frame rescan every N frames**. An ROI that can only shrink is a bug. |\n1282\t| **AP3** | **Sizing K from GE's memory term** | K = 16,384 gave a 32 MB matrix (fine) and needed 4.5 GB/s of XOR (23× over). | K is bound by *time*, not memory (§3.1). Faster wire rate makes decode **harder**. |\n1283\t| **AP4** | **Setting L from the nominal ladder rung** | L = 507 made the conservative rung carry **zero** packets, destroying the ladder's only guarantee. | L is set by the **smallest** rung (§3.1.1); `params.ts` throws at import if a rung cannot hold a whole packet. |\n1284\t| **AP5** | **Running the sender faster than D9 allows** | 2.8× over the half-camera-fps rule → 78% erasure. Looked like poor optics. | D9 is a constraint to satisfy, not a dial to maximise. |\n1285\t| **AP6** | **Narrowing the erasure band instead of raising dwell** | Contradicted the evidence base and cost throughput for no arithmetic reason. | Raise dwell; the band is an assumption about the channel (D18c), not a target. |\n1286\t| **AP7** | **Trusting `getSettings()` / requested capture** | Reports 30/60 fps while delivering 15; defaults to 1080 on the *short* edge. | Measure delivered fps and actual capture dimensions (D14, §6.4). |\n1287\t| **AP8** | **`--use-fake-device-for-media-capture`** | Does not exist. It is `--use-fake-device-for-media-**stream**`. | §14.1. |\n1288\t| **AP9** | **Never offering a torch button** | 3.6× fps gain makes it tempting; an LED on glossy glass destroys a region of the frame. | §6.4. |\n1289\t| **AP10** | **Writing a comment that asserts a file exists** | `prng.ts` claimed `test/fixtures/vectors.json` pinned the wire format. It did not exist. | Generate the artifact in the same commit as the claim (§14.3). |\n1290\t\n1291\t## 18.2 Proof obligations\n1292\t\n1293\tEach load-bearing assumption, what must be true, and what would invalidate it. The PWA offline story is unaffected.\n1352\t\n1353\t### 20.1 Photosensitivity changes a rendering decision (`bf-6d3`)\n1354\t\n1355\tWCAG 2.3.1 caps general flashes at three per second **or** requires the flashing area to\n1356\tstay under the small-safe threshold. A full-bleed high-contrast animation at 12–15 fps for\n1357\thours is a genuine seizure risk.\n1358\t\n1359\t**The mitigation costs the core metric.** Bounding flash area reduces usable screen area →\n1360\tfewer cells → less throughput. The compliant design is therefore **a bounded coded region\n1361\tinside a static surround**, not full-bleed, and the area cost MUST be measured in Phase 3\n1362\trather than assumed. D10's DC balancing is part of this mitigation, not just an\n1363\tauto-exposure fix: constant mean luminance is far less provocative than alternating fields.\n1364\t\n1365\t### 20.2 Delta transfer tensions with the block design (`bf-280`)\n1366\t\n1367\t**A partially-received file *is* \"a file the receiver already has\"** — so\n1368\tresume-after-interruption and delta transfer are one mechanism at two granularities.\n1369\t\n1370\tBut general delta wants **content-defined chunking** (rolling hash, variable boundaries),\n1371\twhich contradicts I1 (L fixed) and D19 (fixed blocks, K derived). Two ways out:\n1372\t\n1373\t1. **Scope delta as a v2 mode with its own block scheme** — cleanest; the fixed-block path\n1374\t   stays untouched.\n1375\t2. **Keep fixed blocks and diff at block granularity** — no rolling hash, but only detects\n1376\t   changes aligned to 192 KB boundaries, so an insertion near the start re-sends\n1377\t   everything after it.\n1378\t\n1379\tOption 2 is dramatically cheaper and probably sufficient for the air-gapped-update case,\n1380\twhere changes are usually appends or whole-component replacements. **Start there.** The\n1381\tnear-term half — robust cross-session resume — has no such tension and ships first.\n1382\t\n1383\t---\n1384\t\n1385\t## 21. The spike does not decide **whether** to build the codec — the\nfountain code, block layer and framing are needed whatever the channel does. It\ndecides **what numbers to build it with**, and those numbers are encoded in the\nframing layer that Phase 1 writes:\n\n| Parameter | Basis today | Sets |\n|---|---|---|\n| Tiling gain (~10×) | measured on *simulated* camera paths | D1, the throughput thesis |\n| Erasure 20–30% | **assumption** (D18c states this) | dwell = 1.6 K (§8.1) |\n| 4 px/module cliff | other devices | D2, §3.1.1's rungs, `bf-1g0` |\n| Delivered fps | a Pixel 6, not ours | D9, D14 |\n| 200 MB/s JS XOR | ~~unmeasured guess~~ **measured: 3,260 MB/s desktop (S1)** | D19's K = 768 |\n\nIt is cheap *precisely because* it skips everything this plan carefully designs: no\nfountain code, no blocks, no compression, no resume, no OPFS, no UI. Sequential\nnumbered packets and a counter suffice — the subject is the channel, not the protocol.\n\n**S1 is already done** (`spike/ge-bench.mjs`, no camera or install needed). A full\nGE decode of one block at K = 768 takes **8 ms** at **3,260 MB/s** on the dev\nmachine — the 200 MB/s budget was ~16× pessimistic, leaving **7.1× margin at\nStage 3** even after a harsh ÷4 phone factor. **R1 is provisionally closed**, pending\na re-run in a browser on the target phone; the ÷4 factor is itself a guess.\n\nS2–S4 (rung sweep, distance sweep, handheld and phone→phone) need the optical rig and\ntwo devices. Kill criteria are fixed in advance in `spike/README.md`, each mapping to\nan existing §18 risk — if a criterion trips, the named risk's fallback applies rather\nthan an improvised one.\n\n**Do not let spike code become product code.** Separate directory, separate\n`package.json`, deleted once the results land.\n\n**Parallel track** (independent of the codec, may run alongside Phases 1–3): PWA shell,\nservice worker, file in/out per platform, pairing splash (`bf-4tb`), version footer\n(`bf-13h`), photosensitivity work (`bf-6d3`). **Sync point:** must merge before Phase 5.\n\n**Scope estimate.** Fountain + GE ≈ 300 lines (corroborated by research). Block layer,\nframing, session ≈ 800. Modulation Stage 1 ≈ 600. Receiver pipeline ≈ 700. If duty-cycling cannot hold the rate, reframe multi-GB as a multi-session workflow (§1.1) |\n\n---\n\n## 18.1 Anti-patterns — mistakes this project has already made\n\nEvery entry below was made *in this repo* and cost real time. They are collected here because\neach was previously buried in the narrative of the section that fixed it, where an implementer\nstarting a later phase would never encounter it.\n\n| # | Anti-pattern | What it looked like | Guard |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **AP1** | **A unit-free \"px/module\"** | Every optical run sat at 2.25 camera px/module while the config said \"4\". Presented as a symbology limit; was a sampling limit. | §2 defines screen px and camera px. Never write \"px/module\" unqualified. |\n| **AP2** | **The ROI ratchet** | A frame where only two tiles decoded shrank the crop to those two; every later frame then saw only that region and could never recover. Erasure 91%, goodput **worse than no cropping**, and it presents as an *optical* fault. | Wide margin (≥35%) **plus a forced full-frame rescan every N frames**. An ROI that can only shrink is a bug. |\n| **AP3** | **Sizing K from GE's memory term** | K = 16,384 gave a 32 MB matrix (fine) and needed 4.5 GB/s of XOR (23× over). | K is bound by *time*, not memory (§3.1). Faster wire rate makes decode **harder**. |\n| **AP4** | **Setting L from the nominal ladder rung** | L = 507 made the conservative rung carry **zero** packets, destroying the ladder's only guarantee. | L is set by the **smallest** rung (§3.1.1); `params.ts` throws at import if a rung cannot hold a whole packet. |\n| **AP5** | **Running the sender faster than D9 allows** | 2.8× over the half-camera-fps rule → 78% erasure. Looked like poor optics. | D9 is a constraint to satisfy, not a dial to maximise. |\n| **AP6** | **Narrowing the erasure band instead of raising dwell** | Contradicted the evidence base and cost throughput for no arithmetic reason. | Raise dwell; the band is an assumption about the channel (D18c), not a target. |\n| **AP7** | **Trusting `getSettings()` / requested capture** | Reports 30/60 fps while delivering 15; defaults to 1080 on the *short* edge. | Measure delivered fps and actual capture dimensions (D14, §6.4). |\n| **AP8** | **`--use-fake-device-for-media-capture`** | Does not exist. It is `--use-fake-device-for-media-**stream**`. | §14.1. |\n| **AP9** | **Never offering a torch button** | 3.6× fps gain makes it tempting; an LED on glossy glass destroys a region of the frame. | §6.4. |\n| **AP10** | **Writing a comment that asserts a file exists** | `prng.ts` claimed `test/fixtures/vectors.json` pinned the wire format. It did not exist. | Generate the artifact in the same commit as the claim (§14.3). |\n\n## 18.2 Proof obligations\n\nEach load-bearing assumption, what must be true, and what would invalidate it. This exists\nbecause the project has a documented history of confident-and-wrong (AP1, AP3, AP4, plus a\n2× formula error), and G7 only makes *one* class of claim executable.\n\n| Assumption | Holds iff | Invalidating evidence | Fallback |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| D19's K = 768 | phone GE ≥ 114.6 MB/s sustained **while thermally throttled** | on-device benchmark under load | K → 512 (2.88× margin), then re-open D5 vs wirehair (R1) |\n| S1's ÷4 phone factor | desktop-to-phone JS gap ≤ 4× | on-device `ge-bench.mjs` | recompute K from the measured figure |\n| D18c's 20–30% erasure | erasure under §13.2 conditions stays ≤ 30% | measured 48% (non-qualifying conditions) | repair code (§8.2) becomes the primary path, not the tail (R12) |\n| The 4 camera px/module cliff | zxing needs ≥ 4 camera px/module under handheld blur | S3 distance sweep under §13.2 conditions | re-derive the rung ladder from the measured cliff |\n| D1's ~10× tiling gain | holds on hardware, not just simulated camera paths | rung sweep on the rig | drop to fewer, larger tiles |\n| D27's duty-cycle economics | 50% duty ≈ 50% heat and completes | long-run thermal profile | multi-session framing (§1.1), or cap the supported file size |\n| Stage 3's value | decode CPU/bit beats QR's | prototype against a worker-pool QR baseline | stay at Stage 2 |\n\n## 19. Open questions\n\n1. **Licensing — decide before Phase 7, consciously.** libcimbar is **MPL-2.0**\n   (file-level copyleft); screenferry is MIT. Porting is legal but makes the repo\n   mixed-license and obliges per-file marking. The failure mode is someone pasting in a\n   function and deciding this by accident. → [`prior-art-libcimbar.md`](../notes/prior-art-libcimbar.md)\n2. **Optimal K and block size on real hardware.** §3.1 is a model, not a measurement.\n   Resolve in Phase 1 (R1).\n3. **Phone→phone viability** at 54 cells. Resolve in Phase 3 (R4).\n4. **Progress UX with no back-channel.** The sender cannot know receiver progress. Over a\n   10-hour transfer this matters far more than over 30 seconds. **Resolve in Phase 5.**\n5. **Should the sender ever stop?** It loops forever; at GB scale \"forever\" may be days.\n   **Resolve in Phase 5.**\n6. **Delta transfer vs fixed blocks** — see §20.2. **Resolve before Phase 4 implementation.**\n7. **Closed-loop negotiation — deferred on evidence.** Bidirectional links are precedented\n   (MAMBA: two phones, 11–28 kbps each way), but MAMBA's measured gain from closing the\n   loop is only **5–20%**, while changing the coding paradigm buys multiples. Reassess\n   after Phase 4. → [`link-adaptation-design.md`](../notes/link-adaptation-design.md)\n8. **SoftLight-style soft hints — the highest-ceiling idea we are not doing.** Per-bit\n   confidence plus a false-positive-tolerant rateless code: **2.2× with fixed parameters**.\n   Blocked on zxing returning hard bytes; natural fit for Stage 3.\n9. **Multi-GB export on iOS** (R5). Detect up front, never at hour 9.\n10. **Encryption.** Out of scope for v1 (T6), but the optical channel is uniquely exposed\n    to filming. Revisit once transport is real.\n\n---\n\n## 20. Adopted roadmap items\n\nFrom [`ideas-ledger.md`](../notes/ideas-ledger.md) (103 generated → 10 finalists → 7\nadopted). Tracked as beads blocking genesis `bf-28p`.\n\n| Bead | Item | Grade | Phase |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `bf-4d6` | Storage pre-flight and capacity gate | S | 4 |\n| `bf-5vm` | Diagnostic stall detector | M | 5 |\n| `bf-1g0` | Aim reticle and distance coach | M | 5 |\n| `bf-6d3` | Photosensitivity safeguard (WCAG 2.3.1) | S | 5 |\n| `bf-280` | Delta transfer and cross-session resume | L | 4+ |\n| `bf-4tb` | Pairing splash QR | S | 5 |\n| `bf-13h` | Verifiable build + version footer | M | 0 |\n\n**Rejected:** *text/secret fast path* (a different product inside this one) and\n*single-file HTML build* (deploying as a static site, and WASM is required — exactly what\nsingle-file cannot cleanly inline). The PWA offline story is unaffected.\n\n### 20.1 Photosensitivity changes a rendering decision (`bf-6d3`)\n\nWCAG 2.3.1 caps general flashes at three per second **or** requires the flashing area to\nstay under the small-safe threshold. A full-bleed high-contrast animation at 12–15 fps for\nhours is a genuine seizure risk.\n\n**The mitigation costs the core metric.** Bounding flash area reduces usable screen area →\nfewer cells → less throughput. The compliant design is therefore **a bounded coded region\ninside a static surround**, not full-bleed, and the area cost MUST be measured in Phase 3\nrather than assumed. D10's DC balancing is part of this mitigation, not just an\nauto-exposure fix: constant mean luminance is far less provocative than alternating fields.\n\n### 20.2 Delta transfer tensions with the block design (`bf-280`)\n\n**A partially-received file *is* \"a file the receiver already has\"** — so\nresume-after-interruption and delta transfer are one mechanism at two granularities.\n\nBut general delta wants **content-defined chunking** (rolling hash, variable boundaries),\nwhich contradicts I1 (L fixed) and D19 (fixed blocks, K derived). Two ways out:\n\n1. **Scope delta as a v2 mode with its own block scheme** — cleanest; the fixed-block path\n   stays untouched.\n2. **Keep fixed blocks and diff at block granularity** — no rolling hash, but only detects\n   changes aligned to 192 KB boundaries, so an insertion near the start re-sends\n   everything after it.\n\nOption 2 is dramatically cheaper and probably sufficient for the air-gapped-update case,\nwhere changes are usually appends or whole-component replacements. **Start there.** The\nnear-term half — robust cross-session resume — has no such tension and ships first.\n\n---\n\n## 21. all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n4\t\n5\t**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n6\t\n7\t---\n8\t\n9\t## Receiver Session State Machine\n10\t\n11\t### States Overview\n12\t\n13\tThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n14\t\n15\t```\n16\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n17\t│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n18\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n19\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n20\t│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n21\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n22\t\n23\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n24\t│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n25\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n26\t│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n27\t│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n28\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n29\t\n30\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n31\t│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n32\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n33\t│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n34\t│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n35\t│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n36\t│                                                                  │\n37\t│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n38\t│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n39\t│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n40\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n41\t```\n42\t\n43\t### Detailed State Specifications\n44\t\n45\t#### 1. IDLE\n46\t**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n47\t**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n48\t\n49\t**Characteristics:**\n50\t- No session state persisted\n51\t- No camera active\n52\t- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n53\t\n54\t**Invariants:**\n55\t- `streamId === null`\n56\t- `meta === null`\n57\t- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n58\t\n59\t---\n60\t\n61\t#### 2. ACQUIRING\n62\t**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n63\t**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n64\t\n65\t**Characteristics:**\n66\t- Camera active, frame loop running\n67\t- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n68\t- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n69\t- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n70\t\n71\t**State fields:**\n72\t```ts\n73\ttype AcquiringState = {\n74\t  type: 'acquiring',\n75\t  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n76\t  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n77\t  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n78\t}\n79\t```\n80\t\n81\t**Transitions:**\n82\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n83\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n84\t- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n85\t\n86\t**Invariants:**\n87\t- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n88\t- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n89\t\n90\t---\n91\t\n92\t#### 3. RECEIVING\n93\t**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n94\t**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n95\t\n96\t**Characteristics:**\n97\t- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n98\t- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n99\t- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n100\t- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n101\t\n102\t**State fields:**\n103\t```ts\n104\ttype ReceivingState = {\n105\t  type: 'receiving',\n106\t  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n107\t  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n108\t  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n109\t  active: {                           // current block being decoded\n110\t    blockIndex: number,\n111\t    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n112\t    rank: number\n113\t  } | null,                           // null = between blocks\n114\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n115\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n116\t  stats: {\n117\t    fps: number,\n118\t    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n119\t    packetsPerSec: number,\n120\t    eta: number,\n121\t    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n122\t  }\n123\t}\n124\t```\n125\t\n126\t**Transitions:**\n127\t- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n128\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n129\t- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n130\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n131\t- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n132\t\n133\t**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n134\t- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n135\t- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n136\t- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n137\t\n138\t**Invariants:**\n139\t- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n140\t- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n141\t- Exactly one block GE-active at a time (I5)\n142\t- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n143\t\n144\t---\n145\t\n146\t#### 4. VERIFYING\n147\t**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n148\t**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n149\t\n150\t**Characteristics:**\n151\t- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n152\t- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n153\t- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n154\t\n155\t**State fields:**\n156\t```ts\n157\ttype VerifyingState = {\n158\t  type: 'verifying',\n159\t  streamId: number,\n160\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n161\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n162\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n163\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n164\t  verificationProgress: {\n165\t    verified: number,\n166\t    total: number,\n167\t    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n168\t  }\n169\t}\n170\t```\n171\t\n172\t**Transitions:**\n173\t- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n174\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n175\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n176\t\n177\t**Invariants:**\n178\t- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n179\t- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n180\t\n181\t---\n182\t\n183\t#### 5. COMPLETE\n184\t**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n185\t**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n186\t\n187\t**Characteristics:**\n188\t- File ready for export\n189\t- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n190\t\n191\t**State fields:**\n192\t```ts\n193\ttype CompleteState = {\n194\t  type: 'complete',\n195\t  streamId: number,\n196\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n197\t  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n198\t  outputSize: number,\n199\t  verified: boolean,\n200\t  compressed: boolean\n201\t}\n202\t```\n203\t\n204\t**Transitions:**\n205\t- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n206\t\n207\t**Invariants:**\n208\t- File exists in OPFS\n209\t- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n210\t\n211\t---\n212\t\n213\t#### 6. PAUSED\n214\t**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n215\t**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n216\t\n217\t**Characteristics:**\n218\t- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n219\t- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n220\t- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n221\t\n222\t**State fields:**\n223\t```ts\n224\ttype PausedState = {\n225\t  type: 'paused',\n226\t  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n227\t  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n228\t  pauseTime: number\n229\t}\n230\t```\n231\t\n232\t**Transitions:**\n233\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n234\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n235\t- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n236\t\n237\t**Invariants:**\n238\t- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n239\t- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n240\t- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n241\t\n242\t---\n243\t\n244\t#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n245\t**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n246\t**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n247\t\n248\t**Characteristics:**\n249\t- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n250\t- UI: Shows repair code input field\n251\t\n252\t**State fields:**\n253\t```ts\n254\ttype RepairWaitingState = {\n255\t  type: 'repair-waiting',\n256\t  streamId: number,\n257\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n258\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n259\t  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n260\t  repairCode: string | null\n261\t}\n262\t```\n263\t\n264\t**Transitions:**\n265\t- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n266\t- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n267\t\n268\t**Invariants:**\n269\t- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n270\t\n271\t---\n272\t\n273\t#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n274\t**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n275\t**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n276\t\n277\t**Characteristics:**\n278\t- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n279\t- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n280\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n281\t\n282\t**State fields:**\n283\t```ts\n284\ttype RepairTransferringState = {\n285\t  type: 'repair-transferring',\n286\t  streamId: number,\n287\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n288\t  complete: Uint8Array,\n289\t  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n290\t  receivedCount: number\n291\t}\n292\t```\n293\t\n294\t**Transitions:**\n295\t- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n296\t- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n297\t\n298\t**Invariants:**\n299\t- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n300\t- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n301\t\n302\t---\n303\t\n304\t#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n305\t**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n306\t**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n307\t\n308\t**Characteristics:**\n309\t- Transfer cannot continue\n310\t- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n311\t- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n312\t\n313\t**State fields:**\n314\t```ts\n315\ttype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n316\t  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n317\t  streamId: number,\n318\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n319\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n320\t  partialOutputPath: string,\n321\t  missingBlocks: number[]\n322\t}\n323\t```\n324\t\n325\t**Transitions:**\n326\t- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n327\t\n328\t**Invariants:**\n329\t- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n330\t- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n331\t- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n332\t\n333\t---\n334\t\n335\t#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n336\t**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n337\t**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n338\t\n339\t**Characteristics:**\n340\t- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n341\t- Compressed artefact is kept\n342\t- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n343\t\n344\t**State fields:**\n345\t```ts\n346\ttype DecompressFailedState = {\n347\t  type: 'decompress-failed',\n348\t  streamId: number,\n349\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n350\t  compressedOutputPath: string,\n351\t  error: string\n352\t}\n353\t```\n354\t\n355\t**Transitions:**\n356\t- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n357\t\n358\t**Invariants:**\n359\t- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n360\t- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n361\t- No data is lost\n362\t\n363\t---\n364\t\n365\t### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n366\t\n367\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n368\t|---|---|---|---|\n369\t| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n370\t| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n371\t| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n372\t| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n373\t| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n374\t| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n375\t| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n376\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n377\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n378\t| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n379\t| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n380\t| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n381\t| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n382\t| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n383\t| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n384\t| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n385\t| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n386\t| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n387\t\n388\t---\n389\t\n390\t## Sender Session State Machine\n391\t\n392\t### States Overview\n393\t\n394\tThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n395\t\n396\t```\n397\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n398\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n399\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n400\t│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n401\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n402\t\n403\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n404\t│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n405\t│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n406\t│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n407\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n408\t```\n409\t\n410\t### Detailed State Specifications\n411\t\n412\t#### 1. IDLE\n413\t**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n414\t**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n415\t\n416\t**Characteristics:**\n417\t- No file selected\n418\t- No active session\n419\t- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n420\t\n421\t**State fields:**\n422\t```ts\n423\ttype IdleState = {\n424\t  type: 'idle'\n425\t}\n426\t```\n427\t\n428\t---\n429\t\n430\t#### 2. SENDING\n431\t**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n432\t**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n433\t\n434\t**Characteristics:**\n435\t- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n436\t- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n437\t- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n438\t- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n439\t\n440\t**State fields:**\n441\t```ts\n442\ttype SendingState = {\n443\t  type: 'sending',\n444\t  source: File,\n445\t  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n446\t  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n447\t  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n448\t  blockCount: number,\n449\t  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n450\t  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n451\t  cursor: {\n452\t    blockIndex: number,\n453\t    seq: number                         // within block\n454\t  },\n455\t  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n456\t  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n457\t  sourceFingerprint: {\n458\t    size: number,\n459\t    lastModified: number\n460\t  }\n461\t}\n462\t```\n463\t\n464\t**Transitions:**\n465\t- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n466\t- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n467\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n468\t- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n469\t\n470\t**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n471\t- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n472\t- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n473\t- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n474\t\n475\t**Invariants:**\n476\t- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n477\t- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n478\t- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n479\t\n480\t---\n481\t\n482\t#### 3. PAUSED\n483\t**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n484\t**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n485\t\n486\t**Characteristics:**\n487\t- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n488\t- State preserved\n489\t- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n490\t\n491\t**State fields:**\n492\t```ts\n493\ttype PausedSenderState = {\n494\t  type: 'paused',\n495\t  previousState: SendingState,\n496\t  pauseTime: number\n497\t}\n498\t```\n499\t\n500\t**Transitions:**\n501\t- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n502\t\n503\t**Invariants:**\n504\t- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n505\t- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n506\t\n507\t---\n508\t\n509\t#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n510\t**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n511\t**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n512\t\n513\t**Characteristics:**\n514\t- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n515\t- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n516\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n517\t\n518\t**State fields:**\n519\t```ts\n520\ttype RepairModeState = {\n521\t  type: 'repair-mode',\n522\t  baseState: SendingState,\n523\t  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n524\t  emittedCount: number,\n525\t  totalTarget: number\n526\t}\n527\t```\n528\t\n529\t**Transitions:**\n530\t- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n531\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n532\t\n533\t**Invariants:**\n534\t- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n535\t- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n536\t\n537\t---\n538\t\n539\t#### 5. STOPPING\n540\t**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n541\t**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n542\t\n543\t**Characteristics:**\n544\t- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n545\t- Frame loop stopped\n546\t- Resources released\n547\t\n548\t**State fields:**\n549\t```ts\n550\ttype StoppingState = {\n551\t  type: 'stopping',\n552\t  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n553\t  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n554\t}\n555\t```\n556\t\n557\t**Transitions:**\n558\t- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n559\t\n560\t**Actions:**\n561\t- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n562\t- Close file handles\n563\t- Release camera/render resources\n564\t\n565\t---\n566\t\n567\t#### 6. COMPLETE\n568\t**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n569\t\n570\t---\n571\t\n572\t### Sender State Transitions Summary\n573\t\n574\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action ...\n621\t};\n622\t```\n623\t\n624\t### State Machine Enforcement\n625\t\n626\t**Use TypeScript discriminated unions:**\n627\t```ts\n628\tfunction handlePacket(state: RecvSessionState, packet: Packet): RecvSessionState {\n629\t  switch (state.type) {\n630\t    case 'acquiring':\n631\t      // Can't route packets yet\n632\t      return state;\n633\t    case 'receiving':\n634\t      // Normal }\n644\t}\n645\t```\n646\t\n647\t**Transition validation:**\n648\t```ts\n649\tfunction transition(from: RecvSessionState, to: RecvSessionState): RecvSessionState {\n650\t  // Assert transition is valid\n651\t  assertValidTransition(from.type, to.type);\n652\t\n653\t  // Run exit/entry actions\n654\t  runExitActions(from);\n655\t  const result = runEntryActions(to);\n656\t  return result;\n657\t}\n658\t```\n659\t\n660\t### State Persistence\n661\t\n662\t**Resume token (D22):**\n663\t```ts\n664\tinterface ResumeToken {\n665\t  streamId: number;\n666\t  meta: BeaconMeta;\n667\t Session State Machine Specification\n\n**Purpose:** Define all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n\n**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n\n---\n\n## Receiver Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n│                                                                  │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No session state persisted\n- No camera active\n- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId === null`\n- `meta === null`\n- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n\n---\n\n#### 2. ACQUIRING\n**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Camera active, frame loop running\n- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype AcquiringState = {\n  type: 'acquiring',\n  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. RECEIVING\n**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype ReceivingState = {\n  type: 'receiving',\n  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n  active: {                           // current block being decoded\n    blockIndex: number,\n    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n    rank: number\n  } | null,                           // null = between blocks\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n  stats: {\n    fps: number,\n    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n    packetsPerSec: number,\n    eta: number,\n    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n\n**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n- Exactly one block GE-active at a time (I5)\n- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n\n---\n\n#### 4. VERIFYING\n**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype VerifyingState = {\n  type: 'verifying',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n  verificationProgress: {\n    verified: number,\n    total: number,\n    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n\n---\n\n#### 5. COMPLETE\n**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- File ready for export\n- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype CompleteState = {\n  type: 'complete',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n  outputSize: number,\n  verified: boolean,\n  compressed: boolean\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n\n**Invariants:**\n- File exists in OPFS\n- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n\n---\n\n#### 6. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n\n---\n\n#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n- UI: Shows repair code input field\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairWaitingState = {\n  type: 'repair-waiting',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n  repairCode: string | null\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n\n---\n\n#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairTransferringState = {\n  type: 'repair-transferring',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,\n  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n  receivedCount: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n\n---\n\n#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer cannot continue\n- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  partialOutputPath: string,\n  missingBlocks: number[]\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n\n---\n\n#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n- Compressed artefact is kept\n- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype DecompressFailedState = {\n  type: 'decompress-failed',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  compressedOutputPath: string,\n  error: string\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n- No data is lost\n\n---\n\n### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n\n---\n\n## Sender Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No file selected\n- No active session\n- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype IdleState = {\n  type: 'idle'\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n#### 2. SENDING\n**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype SendingState = {\n  type: 'sending',\n  source: File,\n  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n  blockCount: number,\n  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n  cursor: {\n    blockIndex: number,\n    seq: number                         // within block\n  },\n  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n  sourceFingerprint: {\n    size: number,\n    lastModified: number\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n\n**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n- State preserved\n- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedSenderState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: SendingState,\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n\n---\n\n#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairModeState = {\n  type: 'repair-mode',\n  baseState: SendingState,\n  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n  emittedCount: number,\n  totalTarget: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n\n---\n\n#### 5. STOPPING\n**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n- Frame loop stopped\n- Resources released\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype StoppingState = {\n  type: 'stopping',\n  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n\n**Actions:**\n- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n- Close file handles\n- Release camera/render resources\n\n---\n\n#### 6. COMPLETE\n**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n\n---\n\n### Sender State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | SENDING | User selects file, starts send | Compress (if enabled), derive streamId, start frame loop |\n| SENDING | PAUSED | Tab backgrounded (E8) | Stop frame loop, preserve state |\n| SENDING | REPAIR_MODE | Repair code entered | Restrict emission to target blocks |\n| SENDING | STOPPING | User cancel / source changed (E5) | Begin graceful shutdown |\n| SENDING | SENDING | Source change detected (E5) | Abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED |\n| PAUSED | SENDING | Tab foregrounded | Resume frame loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | SENDING | Repair complete | Return to normal loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | STOPPING | User cancel | Begin shutdown |\n| STOPPING | IDLE | Cleanup complete | Wipe staging, release resources |\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Guidelines\n\n### Replacing Nullable Fields\n\n**Current problematic pattern (plan.md §7.3):**\n```ts\ntype RecvSession = {\n  streamId: number | null;      // ❌nullable\n  meta: BeaconMeta | null;      // ❌nullable\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n**Replacement: Explicit states**\n```ts\ntype RecvSessionState =\n  | IdleState\n  | AcquiringState\n  | ReceivingState\n  | VerifyingState\n  | CompleteState\n  | PausedState\n  | RepairWaitingState\n  | RepairTransferringState\n  | QuotaExhaustedState\n  | DecompressFailedState;\n\n// Each state has exact fields, no nulls\ntype ReceivingState = {\n  type: 'receiving';\n  streamId: number;           // ✅always present in this state\n  meta: BeaconMeta;           // ✅always present in this state\n  // ...\n};\n```\n\n### State Machine Enforcement\n\n**Use TypeScript discriminated unions:**\n```ts\nfunction handlePacket(state: RecvSessionState, packet: Packet): RecvSessionState {\n  switch (state.type) {\n    case 'acquiring':\n      // Can't route packets yet\n      return state;\n    case 'receiving':\n      // Normal packet routing\n      return routePacket(state, packet);\n    case 'repair-transferring':\n      // Only accept expected blocks\n      if (state.expectedBlocks.has(packet.blockIndex)) {\n        return handleRepairPacket(state, packet);\n      }\n      return state;\n    // ...\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transition validation:**\n```ts\nfunction transition(from: RecvSessionState, to: RecvSessionState): RecvSessionState {\n  // Assert transition is valid\n  assertValidTransition(from.type, to.type);\n\n  // Run exit/entry actions\n  runExitActions(from);\n  const result = runEntryActions(to);\n  return result;\n}\n```\n\n### State Persistence\n\n**Resume token (D22):**\n```ts\ninterface ResumeToken {\n  streamId: number;\n  meta: BeaconMeta;\n  complete: Uint8Array;         // bitmap\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n\n// Only PAUSED and COMPLETE states can be persisted for resume\nfunction canResume(state: RecvSessionState): boolean {\n  return state.type === 'paused' || state.type === 'complete';\n}\n```\n\n### Testing Requirements\n\n**Unit tests:**\n- Every state transition must be tested\n- Invalid transitions must throw\n- State serialization/deserialization for resume\n\n**Integration tests:**\n- Full session lifecycle (IDLE → COMPLETE)\n- All error recovery paths (PAUSED → RECEIVING, E12 re-collect, etc.)\n- Resume flow (D22)\n\n**Property tests:**\n- No forgotten transitions (all nullable field paths covered)\n- State machine is total (no undefined states)\n\n---\n\n## Open Questions & Future Work\n\n1. **D27 duty-cycle integration**: How exactly does duty-cycle trigger PAUSED state?\n   - Proposal: `fps < 0.7 * baselineFps` for > 10s → transition to PAUSED\n   - Requires baseline fps measurement at session start\n\n2. **Resume with compression**: D22 + D8 conflict\n   - Current spec: Resume disabled when compression enabled\n   - Future: Deterministic compression to enable resume\n\n3. **Multi-session framing**: D27 mentions \"multi-GB as multi-session\"\n   - How does session state span multiple browser sessions?\n   - Requires persistent OPFS + explicit session handoff\n\n---\n\n## Appendix: Edge Case Mapping\n\n| Edge Case | State Impact | Primary State(s) |\n|---|---|---|\n| E8: Tab backgrounded (sender) | PAUSED | PAUSED (sender) |\n| E9: Camera lost (receiver) | PAUSED | PAUSED (receiver) |\n| E10: OPFS quota exhausted | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED |\n| E12: Block hash fail | Re-collect block | RECEIVING (self-transition) |\n| E16: Worker crash | Restart worker, discard active block | RECEIVING (sub-transition) |\n| E5: Source changed | Abort with error | STOPPING (sender) |\n| E15: Decompression failed | Keep compressed artefact | DECOMPRESS_FAILED |\n| D22: Resume | Restore from PAUSED | PAUSED ↔ RECEIVING |\n| D27: Duty-cycle | Pause for thermal | PAUSED (thermal) |\n| §7.6: Manifest verification | VERIFYING state | VERIFYING |\n| §8.3: Resume re-verify | VERIFYING on resume | VERIFYING (from PAUSED) |\n","numLines":726,"startLine":1,"totalLines":726}}}
